info.title: POPULAR public API
info.summary: Tokens, trades, candles, holders and wallets of POPULAR, the Sui launchpad and launchpad aggregator.
info.description:
Stable shapes: fields may be added, never renamed or removed. Read-only; trading is Sui transactions the user's wallet signs (https://popularsui.xyz/data/integrators.md).

Units: token amounts are integer strings in 10^-6 token for every venue (each token's `decimals` gives its own on chain); SUI amounts are integer strings in MIST or numbers named *_sui in whole SUI; quote_* amounts are the quote coin's base units; times are Unix ms (*_ms), candle buckets Unix s.

Limits: without a key 30 requests a minute per address; a self-serve key (POST /api/v1/keys/challenge, then POST /api/v1/keys, see https://popularsui.xyz/data.md) gives 120. Cloud networks need a key. The wallet route counts as 5.

Hidden tokens (moderation, fake coins, delisted venues) are never served (a wallet's order on one keeps its amounts and coin types, its token_id, symbol and token_decimals are null). Errors answer JSON {error} with CORS: 400 bad parameter, 401 bad key, 404 unknown token, 429 rate limit, 500 a read failed (retry). Credit "Data: POPULAR (popularsui.xyz), CC BY 4.0".

id.description: The token's id on POPULAR (curve, pool or index id)

venue.description: popular, pair, amped, index, bundle (launched on POPULAR); suipump, perpsplexity, blast (other launchpads); listed (established coins)

package_id.description: Package of the venue's contract the token trades through

decimals.description: The coin's own decimals on chain; token amounts in this API are always 10^-6 token

creator.description: Wallet that launched it (0x0…0 for listed coins)

last_trade_ms.description: Last trade on any of its venues (its launch when none), Unix ms

status.description: trading on its own curve or venue; ready: curve sold out, waiting to graduate; graduated: in its DEX pool; paused

quote.description: Coin type the curve is priced in (0x2::sui::SUI unless a quote curve); prices and volumes are SUI equivalents

pool_id.description: Main DEX pool, once it has one

price_sui.description: SUI per whole token; null when unknown (outside the ranked list and no SUI price on its row)

market_cap_sui.description: price_sui x total supply, SUI; null with price_sui

total_supply.description: Supply in circulation now (burns excluded). 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string

progress.description: Curve progress to graduation, 0..1 (1 once graduated); null when not in the ranked list

raised_mist.description: Raised on the curve (a quote curve: SUI equivalent); null when not in the ranked list. MIST (10^-9 SUI), integer as a string

quote_raised.description: Quote curves: raised in the quote coin; null for SUI curves. Base units of that coin, integer as a string

volume_24h_sui.description: 24 h volume, curve trades and pool swaps, SUI; null when the chart's ranked list does not hold the token

change_24h_pct.description: 24 h price change, percent; null without a reference price

burned_pct.description: Share of the launch supply burned, percent; null when not ranked

score.description: Organic activity score of the last hour, 0..1; null when not ranked

low_liquidity.description: A thin pool: market_cap_sui is a last-trade artifact

cursor.description: Sort key: pass as ?before= for older trades

trader.description: Wallet (a fast trading wallet's trades show its owner, fast true)

sui.description: Buy: SUI paid including the fee; sell: SUI out before the fee (a quote curve: SUI equivalent). MIST (10^-9 SUI), integer as a string

tokens.description: Tokens bought or sold. 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string

fee.description: Fee; 0 for pool swaps. MIST (10^-9 SUI), integer as a string

price_sui.description: SUI per whole token after the trade

source.description: curve: the token's own contract; pool: a swap in its DEX pool

quote_amount.description: Quote curves: the trade in the quote coin. Base units of that coin, integer as a string

quote_fee.description: Quote curves: the fee in the quote coin. Base units of that coin, integer as a string

fast.description: Made by the trader's fast trading wallet

bundle_wallets.description: A bundled buy: wallets the transaction sent the coins to

bundle_to.description: A bundled buy: this row's wallet, when known

pnl.description: A sell's profit or loss (average cost) in the curve's own coin: MIST, or the quote's base units. Base units of that coin, integer as a string

cost.description: Cost of the tokens a sell sold, as pnl. Base units of that coin, integer as a string

sui.description: As Trade.sui: buy, SUI paid including the fee; sell, SUI out of the curve or pool before the fee. MIST (10^-9 SUI), integer as a string

tokens.description: Tokens bought or sold. 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string

balance.description: Free + staked + locked. 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string

locked.description: In vesting locks. 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string

balance.description: Held now: wallet, staked, vesting locks, vested-curve positions, its fast wallets. 10^-6 token (every venue; see decimals), integer as a string
